dedupe_keys.name: china population census yearbook 2020 seventh national population census online tables including the housing volumes

description: The China Population Census Yearbook 2020 is the full tabulation of the Seventh National Population Census, published online by the National Bureau of Statistics as a browsable table set in Chinese. Two volumes are about housing. The short-form housing volume counts family households in each province by number of rooms and by floor area per person. The long-form housing volume, filled in by a 10 percent sample of households, counts households by the height class of their building (single storey, up to 7, 8 to 33, 34 and more storeys) and its load-bearing structure (steel and reinforced concrete, mixed, brick and wood, bamboo, straw or adobe, other), by the period in which the dwelling was built, by the source of the housing (public or other rental, new or second-hand purchase, former public or affordable housing, self-built, inherited) and by whether the dwelling has both a kitchen and a toilet. Every table is given for all households and separately for cities, towns and rural areas. NBS and the census office produce it to document the 2020 census. Format and access: each table is an image and an Excel (XLS) file that can be downloaded without registration; the menu links the images, and the XLS files sit next to them under the same names. Licence: not stated on the yearbook pages; free. Caveats: province is the finest level, long-form figures are sample estimates, the interface is a frameset in GB2312 encoding and Chinese only. Simulation uses: provincial building stock by structural type and age for seismic and flood exposure models, and housing conditions for vulnerability indicators. Related records: the mainland China residential building stock grid, GHSL and WorldPop population grids.
